desc:
🔍 Welcome to Check Your Account Rarity & Stats!

Check your account Rarity, total walk distance, total deaths, total games joined, and your playtime estimation.

🎮 Features:
🕒 Get an estimate of your stats!
🧠 Simple one-click gameplay!
👫 Check how much your friends have played!
✅ 100% game-based, no personal data needed!
